'''Trago Smusch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who worked in the [[Sanads of Rorkee]] hotel, in [[Genarius]] both as a bellhop and as a casino bouncer. He was locally well-known.

He also made some side money working as an informant: Although he could not access to secret information, he was shrewd and noticed too many things others would have liked to keep in secret. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], he noticed some strange activity in the workers of the [[Dorumaa Excavation]] simulation, and he concluded that Dr. [[Shilaea Motacc]], who had been supposedly killed in a cave-in there, was really alive.
